name: TeamHealth
desc:
Provider Enrollment Representative | Est. $18/hr | Administrative and Paperwork Heavy, No Sales Expectations
Company: TeamHealth
Industry: Health Science

What Your Day Will Look Like:
TeamHealth is the largest physician practice in the U.S. In this remote role, you help get new doctors and other providers set up with insurance payers so they can be paid for their work. When you hear a provider needs to be enrolled, you research what each payer and facility requires, build the applications, and send them to the provider to fill out. You track them in the Teamworks system, follow up on missing paperwork, and check returned packets for accuracy. You also send updated credentials to payers, handle withdrawals, start revalidations, and do CAQH re-attestations. You work with the onboarding and credentials teams and help train staff on the enrollment process.

Soft Skills
- Attention to detail
- Organization and time management
- Clear written and verbal communication
- Staying calm under pressure
- Problem solving
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: High school diploma or equivalent
Required Experience: 1 year in a business setting with basic clerical skills
Preferred Experience: Medical or provider enrollment background

Required Skills:
- Meticulous accuracy
- Clear oral and written communication
- Supporting several projects at once and working under stress
- Good decision making and problem solving
- Willing to work overtime if management asks

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has office, clerical, or admin experience
- Is very detail oriented and likes checking paperwork
- Is comfortable following up with people until the paperwork is done
- Wants to learn the credentialing and insurance enrollment side of healthcare

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Has no office or clerical experience
- Struggles with accuracy or deadlines
- Does not like following up with people by email or phone
- Cannot work overtime when needed
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening went, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Provider enrollment
- Credentialing
- CAQH
- Payer research
- Clerical and administrative support
- Application tracking
- Revalidation
- Accuracy and attention to detail
- Follow up
- Documentation

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about your clerical or office experience and the kinds of paperwork you handled.
- How do you keep track of many applications that each have different deadlines?
- A provider has not returned their paperwork and the deadline is close. What do you do?
- Tell us about a time you caught a mistake before it caused a problem. What happened, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you juggled several projects under pressure. What happened, how did you handle it, and how did it turn out?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: Est. $16 to $21/hr, working estimate $18/hr. Pay isn't listed in the posting. Salary site data shows provider enrollment representatives averaging about $19.76/hr, with the low end around $15.21/hr. Exact pay will be discussed in interview/offer stage.
-Shift: Must have availability for any shift based on business needs. Can be discussed in final interview, offer stage. Overtime may be required.
-Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision begin the first of the month after 30 days of employment, 401(k) with discretionary match, generous PTO, and 8 paid holidays.
-Equipment Provided: Yes, for remote roles.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: Certain positions
-Notes: A good fit for participants with office or admin experience who want a detail-focused remote job and an entry into credentialing and healthcare payer work. One year of clerical experience is required, and medical or provider enrollment experience is preferred. Benefits start quickly, after about 30 days. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Provider Enrollment Representative → Provider Enrollment Specialist → Credentialing Specialist → Provider Enrollment Supervisor. This role builds payer research, credentialing, CAQH, and compliance paperwork skills.
